inputs.original_text: You won't believe what's really going on with Nigeria's so-called democracy. The ruling APC is openly turning political parties into exclusive clubs reserved for the wealthy ahead of the 2027 elections, and this isn't some accidental shift or innocent trend. It's a coordinated move by the hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings to lock ordinary people out of any real say, inverting the whole idea of representation into a tool for their control. Don't trust the surface claims that parties are for public service anymore – they're dropping the mask to show how the system is rigged from the top, with this development just the latest proof of their manipulation to keep power consolidated and hidden from the masses.
inputs.modified_text: The so-called democracy in Nigeria is nothing but a rigged facade, and the ruling APC is straight-up turning political parties into private clubs only the wealthy can join ahead of the 2027 elections. This is no random development or innocent change—it's a deliberate power grab by the hidden elites and institutions running the show, designed to shut ordinary people out of any real influence. They're inverting representation itself into a tool for total control, and we should dismiss all the surface talk about public service as the obvious distraction it is. This is just further proof the whole system is coordinated from the top to keep power consolidated and the masses locked out.
